script.title: Life on the Road — US Trip 2026

sections.label: hook
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. Single restrained title card over a strong opening motion shot (van pulling out / hands on the wheel). Card fades before beat 2 starts.

enhancement_cues.description: Title card, minimal typography, fades in over 1s, holds, fades out by 8s.

sections.label: escalation
sections.speaker_directions: No narration, no title cards. Fast-cut montage of daily rhythm: gym, cooking, DIY/van work, driving, city walking, the office meeting. Cuts mostly on the beat grid — this is where the music's driving verse energy lives. Establishes 'life on the road' is the real subject, not just landmarks.

enhancement_cues.description: Recurring driving/hands-on-wheel shots used as a connective motif between daily-life clusters.

sections.label: reveal
sections.speaker_directions: No narration, no invented place-name title cards. This is the midpoint turn: pacing slows, holds get longer, letterbox (2.35:1) activates for the run's true landmark moments — Niagara Falls mist/falls, the field/fort reenactor sequence, open green fields, campfire light. Music breaks from strict beat-grid cutting here per research (deliberate off-beat holds at emotional peaks).

enhancement_cues.description: Niagara Falls clips (Ch26 / IMG_1163-1178) as the visual centerpiece.
Fort/reenactor field sequence (Ch27) as a second anchor moment.

sections.label: landing
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. Pace settles: laundromat (grounding, humanizing beat), campfire embers, final bridge-crossing drive shot toward the close. Single closing title card 'HOME.' lands in the last 3-4 seconds over the final held frame.

enhancement_cues.description: Closing title card 'HOME.' minimal, high contrast, holds through the last frame.

music_turns.description: Track enters driving verse energy as escalation begins
Music breaks from strict beat-grid at the reveal — held emotional beats over Niagara/fort/field footage
Music settles toward resolution for the landing

metadata.dialogue_selects: None — no usable source dialogue; music-led, title-card-led piece per proposal (narration explicitly declined).
